National Service Scheme
About Us
"NOT ME, BUT YOU"
The National Service Scheme (NSS) was established on September 24, 1969, with the objective of developing social responsibility and community service among young people. NSS focuses on various areas, including education, health, environment, and disaster management.
The scheme organizes community service projects, blood donation camps, health awareness programs, tree plantations, and cleanliness drives. Through NSS, volunteers develop social awareness and responsibility, build leadership and teamwork skills, and foster community engagement and participation.
With a structure that spans national, state, and institutional levels, NSS provides opportunities for young people to participate in community service, develop leadership skills, and gain awareness about social issues and community needs.
Email : nssunitkucet@kakatiya.ac.in
Objective
•	Understand the community: Enable students to comprehend the community they serve.
•	Self-understanding: Help students understand themselves in relation to their community.
•	Identify and solve problems: Recognize community needs and problems and involve students in solutions.
•	Develop social responsibility: Foster a sense of social and civic responsibility.
•	Apply knowledge: Utilize knowledge to find practical solutions for community issues.
•	Develop group competence: Acquire skills for group living and sharing responsibilities.
•	Mobilize participation: Gain skills in mobilizing community involvement.
•	Acquire leadership: Develop leadership qualities and a democratic attitude.
•	Meet emergencies: Build capacity to respond to emergencies and disasters.
•	Practice national integration: Promote national integration and social harmony.
Introduction
• The KUCET NSS unit was established in February 2012.
• Its objective is to promote social awareness, community service, and skill development among students.
• Activities include blood donation camps, health awareness programs, tree plantations, and cleanliness drives.
• The unit comprises 2 divisions (Unit I and Unit II), each with 100 registered volunteers.
• The unit is led by Programme Officers Dr. D. Sailaja and M. Soujanya.
• The mission is to foster social responsibility and encourage community participation among students.

Achievements
P.Akhila of 3rd ECE , National Youth Festival as a part of Viksit Bharat Young Leader Dialogue VBYLD-2026 at New Delhi.
P.Akhila of 3rd ECE is going to participate in National Youth Festival as a part of Viksit Bharat Young Leader Dialogue VBYLD-2026 at New Delhi.
Felicitation to NSS Units of KUCE&T by Red Cross Society.
Held on June 15, 2025, for World Blood Donor Day, the Indian Red Cross Society and Chief Guest Registrar of KU, Prof. V. Ramachandram, felicitated KUCE&T Principal Dr. N. Ramana, along with NSS Program Officers Dr. D. Sailaja and M. Soujanya.
The recognition honored their contribution of 151 blood samples, the third highest in Warangal district for the 2024-25 academic year.
Viksit Bharat Youth  Parliament
From March 22–23, 2025, 120 NSS volunteers from KU College of Engineering & Technology registered on the My Bharat portal, with 10 participating in the Viksit Bharat Youth Parliament at Kakatiya University’s Department of Commerce.
N. Sravya (3rd CSD) and T. Karthik (3rd IT) were selected for the State Level Competitions in Hyderabad, reflecting their exceptional communication, leadership, and vision for a developed India.
Mega Blood Donation Camp
The NSS Units of KU College of Engineering & Technology proudly secured the third highest number of blood samples collected in the entire
Warangal district
during the academic year 2024–25.
This remarkable achievement was a result of consistent awareness drives, the dedication of student volunteers, and active collaboration with the Indian Red Cross Society.
The milestone reflects the strong spirit of community service and social responsibility instilled in the volunteers, as well as the effective leadership of the NSS program officers.

National Integration Camp (NIC)

International Yoga Day
On the occasion of International Yoga Day on 21/06/2025,KU College of Engineering and Technology NSS Unit I & Unit II organized an awareness program on "Benefits of Yoga for Physical & Mental Health."
Volunteers from Oneness Ekam A.Manasa and V.Gayathri and yoga instructor P.
Ramu guided students and faculty on the importance of yoga and meditation.
On this occasion, Dr. N. Ramana, NSS POs Dr. D. Sailaja, M. Soujanya, PD Dr. K. Sridhar Kumar, Dr. V. Mahender, Dr. Ch. Radhika, Dr. Md. Asim Iqbal, D.Bhagya laxmi, teaching and non-teaching faculty actively participated in the event.
Morning,KU College of Engineering and Technology NSS Volunteers at the University Basketball court on International Yoga Day celebrations.
International Day Against Drug Abuse
Held on 26 June,2025 at KU College of Engineering and Technology students actively participated in International day  against Drug Abuse on 26/06/2025,Jointly organized by District Legal Service Authority ,Hank, Anti-Narcotic bureau and KU NSS Units.
On this occasion KUCE&T students received certificates and prizes for 3rd prize in Elocution and 1st & 3rd prize in Quiz.
NSS Special camp at KU campus
NSS Unit I and Unit II conducted a 8 day Special camp from 30/06/2025 to 07/07/2025 on Kakatiya University Campus Cleaning program -Swachhata Campus.
All the volunteers from CSE,IT,CSD,ECE,Mech,Civil&EEE  branches actively participated.
Kakatiya University Vice Chancellor visited our camp and appreciated our team.
Plantation program on World Environment Day at K-HUB.
Held on June 5, 2025, for World Environment Day, NSS Units I and II volunteers from KU College of Engineering & Technology (KUCE&T) participated in a plantation program at K-Hub.
The event was inaugurated by Kakatiya University Vice-Chancellor Prof. K. Pratap Reddy, promoting environmental conservation.
NSS "Clean and Green" Activity by Final-Year Civil Engineering Students”
Held on April 28, 2025, final-year Civil Engineering students of KU College of Engineering and Technology participated in an NSS "Clean and Green" program, engaging in a campus cleanliness and beautification drive.
Their enthusiasm and dedication highlighted environmental awareness, embodying the NSS spirit of service, responsibility, and community involvement.
Celebration of Dr. B.R. Ambedkar’s Birth Anniversary at KUCE&T
Held on April 11, 2025, NSS Units I and II of KU College of Engineering & Technology, Kakatiya University, celebrated Dr. B.R. Ambedkar’s birth anniversary, honoring his role as the architect of the Indian Constitution and a social justice champion.
The event featured a seminar and quiz competition, inspiring students and raising awareness about his contributions to modern India.
Health Awareness Program Conducted on World Health Day
Held on April 7, 2025, KU College of Engineering and Technology organized a Health Awareness Program at Government High School, Pegadapally, for World Health Day.
The initiative educated students on good health, personal hygiene, balanced nutrition, and preventive care through interactive sessions and talks, encouraging healthy lifestyle practices.
This outreach highlights the institution’s dedication to community welfare and health education.
Clean and Green" Program by NSS Units at KUCE&T.
Held on March 28, 2025, NSS Units I and II of KU College of Engineering & Technology organized a "Clean and Green" program to promote environmental awareness and campus cleanliness.
Final-year students from ECE, EEE, CSE, and IT departments actively participated, enhancing the campus while fostering environmental responsibility and teamwork.
The event embodied the NSS spirit and students’ commitment to a cleaner, greener future.
Mega Blood Donation Camp Organized by NSS Units of KUCE&T in Collaboration with IRCS
Held on March 10, 2025, the NSS Units of KU College of Engineering & Technology (KUCE&T), in collaboration with the Indian Red Cross Society, organized a Mega Blood Donation Camp.
Inaugurated by Vice-Chancellor Prof. K. Pratap Reddy, Registrar Prof. V. Ramachandram, Red Cross Chairman Dr. P. Vijaychander Reddy, NSS Coordinator Prof. Esam Narayana, and Principal Dr. N. Ramana, the event saw 190 students register and 151 blood units collected.
Managed by NSS volunteers and Red Cross medical staff, it showcased the youth’s vital role in community health.
Motivational Visit to Bheemaram Govt High School
Held on March 1, 2025, the NSS team from KU College of Engineering and Technology visited Bheemaram Government School to motivate SSC (10th class) students.
Eight volunteers engaged in one-on-one and group interactions, offering study tips, encouragement, and sharing personal academic journeys to inspire hard work, time management, and positivity during exam preparation.
Library Books Alignment
Held on February 22, 2025, the NSS volunteers at KU College of Engineering and Technology organized a meaningful library book alignment activity.
Aimed at enhancing library management, it involved students and faculty, promoting discipline and collective service per NSS values of
“Not Me, But You.”
Well-received by the library staff and academic community, it underscored the impact of volunteer efforts on institutional infrastructure.
Clean and Green program conducted on campus
Held on February 8, 2025, at KU College of Engineering and Technology (KUCE&T), the "Clean and Green" program promoted environmental awareness with enthusiastic participation from students and staff.
Focused on campus cleanliness and beautification, it fostered eco-conscious habits, reflecting the institution’s commitment to sustainability.
